If you run a site at Pithampur, Sanwer Road, or Dewas Naka, you already know the problem: you need an office, a security cabin, or a worker room on the plot fast, and you need it to survive an Indore summer. SAMAN builds that cabin. We manufacture IS 2062 MS-frame porta cabins at our Greater Noida factory and send them down to Indore in 3 to 5 days, ready to drop onto your plinth and use. Single security post or a full multi-room contractor office — for a porta cabin in Indore, call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937 and we'll quote it.

Why Buy Your Porta Cabin From SAMAN

Search "porta cabin in Indore" and you get IndiaMART supplier cards and a handful of local cabin makers. Most of them tell you the cabin is durable and cost-effective and leave it there. They don't tell you the steel grade, the panel thickness, or how the thing is anchored. For a Pithampur auto-ancillary plot or a warehouse site off the AB Road, that detail is the difference between a cabin that lasts and one that rusts through its second monsoon.

We're a manufacturer, so when you call you talk to the people who actually build it. Here's what's standard on every SAMAN porta cabin:

  • A frame in IS 2062 Grade A mild steel hollow sections — welded, primed, powder-coated, then anchor-bolted to your plinth so it doesn't shift.
  • 50 mm PUF sandwich panel walls. That insulation is what keeps the cabin bearable when Indore crosses 40°C in May.
  • A colour-coated GI roof pitched to throw monsoon water off cleanly, with a false ceiling under it.
  • A pre-wired board — MCB, ELCB earthing, points and tube-light provision — so you plug in and work.

The paperwork is real too. We hold ISO 9001:2015 (E20250218645), ISO 14001:2015 (E20250218646), and ISO 45001:2018 (E20250218647), plus NSIC (NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207) and DPIIT (DIPP56005) recognition. We started back in 2009 and incorporated in 2019 as SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd — POS stands for Portable Office Solutions. Over 500 projects delivered so far, and our porta cabins go out to sites all over the country.

Delivery runs ₹3,000 as standard, transit to Indore is 3–5 days, and returns are 7 days with the return freight on you.

Where Porta Cabins Go to Work in Indore

Indore's industrial spread gives porta cabins plenty to do, and the right cabin depends on where it's going:

Pithampur (PIN 454775): the big auto and engineering belt out toward Dhar. Plants here run greenfield expansions and shutdown jobs that need contractor offices and gate security cabins, often several at once. Plot entries almost always want a compact guard cabin.

Sanwer Road industrial area (PIN 452015): engineering, fabrication, and a growing warehouse cluster. This is supervisor-office and site-store territory, plus security posts at the larger logistics plots.

Dewas Naka and the Lasudia belt (PIN 452010): mixed manufacturing and trading units closer to the city. Smaller cabins mostly: a guard room here, a two-room office there.

And then there's the construction side — the Indore Metro, the ring-road and AB Road widening work, and the warehouse boom along the Indore-Dewas corridor. Every one of those sites runs on porta cabins as the site office and the security gate while the build is on.

Because we dispatch from Greater Noida down through Agra, Gwalior and Guna on the AB Road corridor, Indore sits on a clean 3–5 day run from our factory. We also serve the wider central India belt from the same route — it's the factory-direct service behind our porta cabin in Bhopal and porta cabin in Raipur deliveries.

What You're Actually Getting — Specifications

Built for Indore heat and a proper monsoon.

Frame: IS 2062 Grade A MS hollow sections, welded and zinc-phosphate primed, powder-coated, anchor-bolted to an RCC plinth.

Panels: 50 mm PUF sandwich panel as standard — that's the insulation that earns its keep in May. Cement-board panel if you want a tougher skin for a long outdoor posting.

Roof: colour-coated GI sheet, pitched for drainage, false ceiling underneath. Turbo ventilators if the plot has no shade — and most Pithampur plots don't.

Floor: anti-skid chequered MS plate, or laminate if it's an office you'll sit in all day.

Doors and windows: MS frame, powder-coated, louvre or sliding windows, fixed glazing if you ask. All fitted at the factory, not bodged on site.

Electricals: MCB board pre-wired, 2 to 4 points a room, tube-light points, ELCB earthing.

Sizes off the shelf: 8×10, 10×12, 10×20, 10×30, 10×40 ft. Odd size? We'll build to it.

Layouts: single room, two-room, a full multi-room block, with an attached toilet or a pantry if you need one.

What People in Indore Use Them For

  • Guard cabins on the gate at Pithampur and Sanwer Road plots
  • Multi-room contractor offices on greenfield and warehouse builds
  • Worker accommodation blocks on the bigger project sites
  • Site stores for tools and material at project yards
  • Supervisor cabins and small two-room offices at Dewas Naka units
  • Site-management offices on the Metro and ring-road stretches

Customising It to Your Site

Most orders aren't the bare standard cabin. Common changes:

  • Custom size and multi-room layouts
  • Light exterior RAL colour to cut the solar heat — sensible for Indore
  • AC provision (wall sleeve cut and a power point) for an office you'll use through summer
  • Turbo ventilator and false ceiling for the open, shadeless plots
  • Internal partitions, extra doors or windows
  • Plumbing run for an attached toilet or washroom
  • Two-storey stacking where the load numbers allow it

Tell us the plot and the use; we'll confirm the spec and the price at quote stage.

What a Porta Cabin Costs in Indore

There's no single sticker price, because no two cabins are the same. What moves the number:

  1. Size — an 8×10 single room is the floor, a 10×40 block the ceiling.
  2. Panel — standard PUF, or cement board for a tougher build.
  3. Fit-out — bare shell, or fully done with wiring, flooring, paint and AC.
  4. Heat kit — ventilator, false ceiling, AC provision if it's a working office.
  5. Quantity — order five or more and the per-unit price comes down.

For a real number on your size and site, call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937.

Getting It to Your Indore Site

We load on a flatbed at Greater Noida and run it down the AB Road corridor — the same factory-direct route we run to Delhi NCR and onward. Three to five days in transit. When it lands, we set it on your pre-cast RCC plinth, anchor-bolt it, check the panels, and connect the board. A single room is usable within hours; a multi-room block takes about a day to settle. Delivery is ₹3,000 standard — ask for a combined rate if you're taking several. One thing to be clear about: we don't have a yard or branch in Indore. Every cabin is built to your order at the factory and trucked straight to your plot.

Frequently Asked Questions — Porta Cabin in Indore

Do you deliver porta cabins to Pithampur and Sanwer Road?

Yes — Pithampur, Sanwer Road, Dewas Naka, and construction sites right across Indore. The cabin ships from our Greater Noida factory and takes 3–5 days in transit. Delivery is ₹3,000 standard.

How does the cabin hold up in Indore's summer heat?

The 50 mm PUF panels are real insulation, not just a skin, and we'd push you toward a turbo ventilator and false ceiling for any open Pithampur-type plot with no shade. For an office you'll sit in all summer, add an AC provision and pick a light exterior colour. Done that way it stays workable past 40°C; a bare cabin in full sun won't.

What does a porta cabin cost in Indore?

It depends on size, panel type, how much fit-out you want, and quantity. We don't publish a fixed price because every cabin is built to order — call +91 87960 39938 or send an enquiry and we'll quote your exact spec.

Can you supply for an Indore Metro or industrial project?

Yes. We supply contractors and project managers, and our NSIC, DPIIT, ISO certificates, GST registration and incorporation papers are ready for vendor empanelment. Send us the project scope and we'll confirm what we can supply and by when.

How long from order to delivery in Indore?

Transit is 3–5 days once the cabin's built. Production time depends on the configuration and where you land in our queue — standard sizes move quicker. We'll give you a firm timeline at enquiry.

Get a Porta Cabin in Indore

Need a porta cabin in Indore — for a Pithampur plot, a warehouse build, or a city construction site? Call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937, or drop your requirement in the enquiry form. We'll come back with the right spec for your plot, a delivery date, and a firm price. You can also browse our full range of factory-built porta cabin site offices for sizes and configurations.
